content.comment_body: Sales and delivery release of firmware V2.2.11 for [product_name] [product_name] ([article_no]) and [product_name] [product_name] ([article_no]) is now available for download. Note that currently, the information is only provided in German. Firmware V2.2.11 succeeds V2.2.10 and features key enhancements focused on supporting secure communications between [product_name] [product_name] and the updated [product_name] BM [version_no]. Product description: The [product_name] CMR2020/2040 can be used together with the [product_name] logic module or as a standalone solution for cost-efficient remote monitoring and control via SMS, email, or telephone. Firmware V2.2.11 is essential for users who wish to monitor or control the newer [product_name] BM with version [version_no] using the [product_name] CMR. Due to recent security changes, encrypted connections are now required for process data exchange between the [product_name] CMR and [product_name] BM. This firmware introduces several enhancements: - Full support for encrypted communication between [product_name] CMR and devices running BM V8.4. - SHA512 support, including updated certificates like 'LOGORootCert' and 'LOGOProductCert' for BM V8.4 in the WBM. - Improved certificate upload process with '.pem file' filtering. - Memory usage fix when loading configuration files. Security notice: This release increases system robustness; updating is recommended. Download information: - Devices running FW V2.x can be updated via Web Based Management (WBM). - V2.2.11 remains compatible with BM devices earlier than V8.4. - Upgrades from FW V2.2.x to earlier FW V2.1.x or V2.0.x aren't possible for modules with hardware version 3. Downgrades are possible for modules with hardware versions 1 and 2. - Downgrading from version V2.x to V1.x is not supported. - Compatibility with configuration files from V2.0.12, V2.1.4, V2.1.5, V2.1.7, V2.1.8, and V2.2.10 is guaranteed; older settings are kept and new functions defaulted. - Configurations from firmware V1.x are no longer supported.

analysis.insight_summary: The thread announces firmware V2.2.11 for [product_name] [product_name], focusing on enhanced encryption for communication with BM V8.4, expanded certificate handling, and memory improvements. The upgrade improves reliability and security but places restrictions on downgrade options and config file compatibility for older systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a smooth firmware update process with improved security and compatibility for existing configurations, expecting reliable system operation and preservation of data integrity.
